001
002package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
005import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticContext;
006import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.format.IPathFormatter;
007import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IKindTest;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFieldDefinition;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFieldInstance;
013
014import java.net.URI;
015
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
018
019/**
020 * A Metapath node valued item representing a Metaschema module field.
021 */
022public interface IFieldNodeItem
023    extends IModelNodeItem<IFieldDefinition, IFieldInstance>,
024    IAtomicValuedNodeItem {
025  /**
026   * Get the static type information of the node item.
027   *
028   * @return the item type
029   */
030  @NonNull
031  static IItemType type() {
032    return IItemType.field();
033  }
034
035  @Override
036  default NodeItemKind getNodeItemKind() {
037    return NodeItemKind.FIELD;
038  }
039
040  @Override
041  default NodeType getNodeType() {
042    return NodeType.FIELD;
043  }
044
045  @Override
046  default IFieldNodeItem getNodeItem() {
047    return this;
048  }
049
050  @Override
051  default IKindTest<IFieldNodeItem> getType() {
052    StaticContext staticContext = getStaticContext();
053    return IItemType.field(
054        getQName(),
055        getDefinition().getDefinitionQName().toEQName(staticContext),
056        staticContext);
057  }
058
059  @Override
060  default IAtomicOrUnionType<?> getValueItemType() {
061    return getDefinition().getJavaTypeAdapter().getItemType();
062  }
063
064  @Override
065  @Nullable
066  default URI getBaseUri() {
067    INodeItem parent = getParentNodeItem();
068    return parent == null ? null : parent.getBaseUri();
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  default @NonNull
073  String format(@NonNull IPathFormatter formatter) {
074    return formatter.formatField(this);
075  }
076
077  @Override
078  default <CONTEXT, RESULT> RESULT accept(@NonNull INodeItemVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> visitor, CONTEXT context) {
079    return visitor.visitField(this, context);
080  }
081
082  @Override
083  default boolean deepEquals(ICollectionValue other, DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
084    return other instanceof IFieldNodeItem
085        && NodeComparators.compareNodeItem(this, (IFieldNodeItem) other, dynamicContext);
086  }
087}
